en.bdb: Many are green grocers, many are makers of kuppas, large vessels made from raw hide usually for holding and carrying oil, and may more are butchers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਮੁਨਿਆਰ ਲਖ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਅਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa muniaar lakh ketaRiaa chamiaar araiee|

en.bdb: Many are toy and bangle sellers and many are leather workers and vegetable growers-cum-sellers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੰਗਹੇਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਬਗਨੀਗਰਾਂ ਕਲਾਲ ਹਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bha(n)gahere hoi ketaRe baganeegaraa(n) kalaal havaiee|

en.bdb: Many are toy and bangle sellers and many are leather workers and vegetable growers-cum-sellers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਭੰਗੀ ਪੋਸਤੀ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੋਫੀ ਘਣੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe bha(n)gee posatee amalee sofee ghanee lukaiee|

en.bdb: Millions drink hemp and many are brewers of wine from rice and barley, and confectioners are also many there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਕਹਾਰ ਲਖ ਗੁਜਰ ਲਖ ਅਹੀਰ ਗਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa kahaar lakh gujar lakh aheer ganaiee|

en.bdb: Millions of cattle breeders, palanquin bearers and milk-men may be presently counted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਹੀ ਲਖ ਚੂਹੜੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤਿ ਅਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe hee lakh choohaRe jaat ajaat sanaat alaiee|

en.bdb: Millions of scavengers and outcaste pariahs (chandal) are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਥਾਵ ਲਖ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit_en: naav thaav lakh keem na paiee ||23||

en.bdb: Thus myriads are names and places which cannot be counted.
